clusters.name: Your sister Bea's birth, 1995-1996
clusters.reason: Around your sister Bea's birth in March 1995, within about a year and a half: your mother Lena's being worn out and on edge with the baby, your parents' distance as your father worked late most nights, your stomach aches and missing school, your brother Jonah's shouting matches with your father, and your mother not going back to her job run from August 1995 to September 1996, with nothing more until your move to the city in 2003, where it settles.
